title: OFM live value
description: Payload of every property topic {enterprise}/{site}/{area}/{line}/{machine}/{property} (and sub-asset properties one level deeper). Published retained. An empty (zero-byte) retained message is not a payload: it clears a retired or renamed topic (ADR-0004).

v.description: Value after normalisation, in the engineering unit given in the property's _meta topic. Its JSON type follows the _meta datatype. Null only when there is no last known value and quality is bad.
